patch.summary: Vonage cost guide: researched plan structure, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

scenarios.body: Budget risk: Taxes and regulatory fees sit on top of published per-line floors. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Taxes and regulatory fees sit on top of published per-line floors

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Call recording and deeper CRM land on Advanced / Premium packaging

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: No power dialer — not a high-volume outbound dialer product

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: AI packaging is thin versus Dialpad/OpenPhone/Talkdesk peers

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Contact Center is a separate product line, not included in VBC Mobile
